span.p:
DEMO_ACTUATOR_CMD (0x01)
generation: u32 | state_generation: u32 | produced_us: u64
outputs_us: u16[4] | state_bits: u16 | rate_hz: u16 | freshness_token: u32

DEMO_BACKEND_STATUS (0x04)

freshness_token: u32 | fault_flags: u32 | capabilities: u16
rate_hz: u16 | contract_id: u16 | lease_state: u8 | backend_bits: u8 | loop_count: u32

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
DEMO_BATTERY_BASE (0x12)
source_id: u16 | valid_mask: u16 | acq_gen: u32 | sample_age_us: u32
voltage_mV: u32 | current_mA: i32 | remaining_permille: u16
warning: u8 | cells: u8 | source_state: u16 | source_errors: u32

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
